messages:
deploy-bot: rollout complete: inference-proxy v2.14 -> prod-west (100%). rollout_id=r-2026-0610-331. tagging for post-deploy checks :white_check_mark:
kevin: nice. can everyone keep an eye on postdeploy synthetics for the next 30m? specifically embed endpoints :eyes:
jess: smoke-probe-bot showing canary ok, but postdeploy synthetic jobs just reported a tail latency jump on /v1/embed in prod-west :thinking_face:
smoke-probe-bot: Synthetic run 1748500020: route=/v1/embed region=prod-west samples=500 p50=28ms p95=410ms p99=820ms errors=0.6% (baseline p95=110ms). logs -> https://internal/reports/1748500020
maria-oncall: who has the quickest hypothesis? high p95 without error spike suggests latency (maybe kv-warmup or batching)
taro: v2.14 changed dynamic batching thresholds + a small kv-cache prefetch tweak. increased batch window to 12ms. might explain tail under low QPS.
amy-qa: we ran unit load tests with synthetic token lengths ~80-120; didn't catch 1k token cases. this synthetic run shows some long sequences at p99. could be tokenization/regression.
jess: can we get a per-instance timeline? is it wide or single host?
smoke-probe-bot: breakdown by host: 5 hosts with elevated p95, 2 hosts at normal. CPU and GPU utilization normal. kernel queues show occasional 30ms spikes in attention kernel on affected hosts.
kevin: suggestion: hold rollout in prod-west. pin routing to previous variant v2.13 in that region while we triage. we can keep global traffic on v2.14 for other regions.
maria-oncall: +1 hold. set a 20m timer and escalate if no improvement.
taro: if we pin, we should also capture heap/profile from one affected host. can we get a debug trace?
jess: i'll trigger diag collection and grab a flame/kv hit rate. command to pin: `routingctl pin --service inference-proxy --version v2.13 --region prod-west --reason "postdeploy p95 spike"`
kevin: executing pin now.

deploy-bot: routing change applied: inference-proxy pinned to v2.13 in prod-west. traffic shifted (100% -> v2.13) in ~45s. change_id=c-7742. :white_check_mark:
amy-qa: running smoke again now.
smoke-probe-bot: Synthetic run 1748500500: route=/v1/embed region=prod-west samples=520 p50=26ms p95=115ms p99=210ms errors=0.1% (improved).
jess: looks much better post-pin. collecting diag from affected hosts now, will upload artifacts.
taro: good. we'll analyze kernel traces but pin accepted as rollback-lite. can we add a follow-up postmortem if root cause is confirmed?
maria-oncall: yes open incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime + sre. set severity low because no user-facing errors, but perf impact noted.
kevin: reminder to update release notes and changelog for v2.14 reverting dynamic-batching change until we can safely re-run tests covering long-sequence tails.
amy-qa: i'll add longer sequence tests to the preflight and a small synthetic harness for token lengths >512.
jess: thanks all. closing hold. if no further regressions in 2h we can attempt a patched rollout with reduced batch window. :thumbsup:
smoke-probe-bot: follow-up run 1748501700 (10m post-pin): p95=108ms p99=195ms errors=0.1% stable.
kevin: filing follow-up: https://internal/infra/tickets/INC-2026-184 (runtime+sre+qa).
maria-oncall: good call on pin. moving to postmortem phase when we have traces. :mag:
deploy-bot: note: v2.14 remains deployed in other regions. rollback in prod-west was a regional pin, not a global rollback.
kevin: thread summary: prod-west pin to v2.13 due to post-deploy p95 spike on /v1/embed; diag collected; ticket opened; next step = attempt patched rollout after extended synthetic coverage.
